mobile_login.title: Retrieve the Bluetooth security key
mobile_login.description: Choose the app where this device is registered. This is a one-time login to the app's private service; your password and session are not saved. Google, Apple, captcha and multi-factor sign-ins are not automated. For email login, the country code is optional and otherwise follows the QR-login region.

data_description.country_code: Only required for phone-number login, for example 44 for the UK or 1 for the US. If supplied for email login, this value overrides the regional default.

mobile_result.title: App login could not recover the key
mobile_result.description: You can retry explicitly or continue without replacing any existing working keys. Successfully retrieved device metadata remains available for diagnostics.

reconfigure.description: Check the Bluetooth connection to this Tuya BLE protocol v4 device again. The device disconnects briefly during the check. Keep it close to Home Assistant and close the Smart Life app first. Your entities and settings are kept.

user.description: Choose how to get this device's credentials. Logging in with the Smart Life app is recommended.

menu_options.login: Log in with the Smart Life or Tuya Smart app (recommended)

login.description: Enter your Tuya User Code (found in Smart Life app: Me > Settings > Account and Security > User Code).

manual.title: Enter device credentials
manual.description: Use this only if logging in with the app cannot find your device. Home Assistant checks the credentials over Bluetooth before adding the device, so keep it nearby and close the Smart Life app first. The keys are stored only in Home Assistant and are never shown again.

data_description.sec_key: Only for devices that use the newer Security V2 Bluetooth login.
data_description.category: The Tuya category code, for example szjqr for a Fingerbot.

credentials.title: Replace the device keys
credentials.description: Enter the device's new local key and, only if it uses one, its security key. Both keys are replaced together and the device reconnects with them; leave the security key empty to remove the stored one. The device ID, UUID, entities and settings are kept. The stored keys are never shown, and the new ones are not checked over Bluetooth before they are saved.

connection.title: Connection settings
connection.description: Keeping the Bluetooth connection open gives the fastest response, but uses one connection slot on the Bluetooth adapter or proxy and drains battery-powered devices faster. With it off, Home Assistant connects for each command, which adds about 1 to 3 seconds, and disconnects after the idle delay. The device then stays available while Home Assistant receives its Bluetooth advertisements. Changing these settings reloads the device.

data_description.idle_disconnect_delay: Only used when the connection is not kept open. Each command restarts the delay, so a burst of commands shares one connection.
data_description.status_poll_interval: Only used when the connection is not kept open. How often to connect and read the device's values, so sensors stay current without commands. Enter 0 to turn it off, for example for a Fingerbot.
